context_and_flow.ux_intent: To encourage new user registration and provide access for existing users.
ux_patterns: The illustration is a decorative, flat-style vector graphic featuring a document, pen, heart, and star.
The CTA for 'Sign up with email' is prominently highlighted in dark green compared to the outlined social buttons.
Standard iOS top status bar and bottom gesture bar.
Good hierarchy between primary registration options and secondary login.
